requirements.required_evidence: Intended isolated project/cluster/database identifier and endpoint fingerprint
requirements.handling: No credentials; prove it differs from the previously referenced Supabase target.

actual_evidence.basis: Exact owner-supplied project ID/URL confirmed by provider; distinct from the preserved June project.
actual_evidence.limits: Identity verification only; no baseline adoption.

requirements.required_evidence: Development-only purpose, region, provider/account and isolation boundary
requirements.handling: No production resource provisioning or shared old data assumed.

actual_evidence.basis: Owner supplied this fresh project for the nonproduction Phase0 continuation; same known organization, region us-west-2, distinct project/endpoint, created 2026-10-27 UTC.
actual_evidence.limits: Logical project separation verified; not a claim about shared provider infrastructure or production account controls.

requirements.required_evidence: Data-preservation and disposal obligations for both old and proposed targets
requirements.handling: Explicitly identify whether any data exists; never infer emptiness from a greenfield label.

actual_evidence.basis: Preserve the old project and all provider-managed schemas. No app/public relations exist in the new target, and no disposal action is authorized.
actual_evidence.limits: Managed Auth/Storage records, backup/retention obligations and any later disposable replay permission remain unverified.

requirements.required_evidence: Postgres exact version, installed extensions and Supabase/Auth managed schemas
requirements.handling: Identify schemas/roles the application must not own or recreate.

actual_evidence.basis: Database reports PostgreSQL 17.11; provider release 17.11.0.003. Extensions, managed namespaces and role capabilities captured in catalog.
actual_evidence.limits: Managed objects stay outside application migration ownership.

requirements.required_evidence: Actual migration ledger, checksums and application namespace emptiness
requirements.handling: New database ledger may be empty, but capture actual evidence; never mark old migrations applied to hide gaps.

actual_evidence.basis: Catalog confirms no app/public relations and no Prisma migration ledger anywhere; Supabase migration tool returns an empty history.
actual_evidence.limits: Empty application namespace only; managed schemas may contain provider/user records. No replay performed.

requirements.handling: Compare reviewed candidate and actual isolated target; Prisma model count alone is insufficient.

actual_evidence.basis: Complete pre-migration catalog captured for comparison.
actual_evidence.limits: No reviewed candidate schema, migration or full post-replay parity yet.

requirements.handling: Include objects not represented by Prisma; classify privileged function behavior.

actual_evidence.basis: Views/functions/triggers/ownership/search-path fingerprints captured; public RLS event-trigger definition inspected as metadata.
actual_evidence.limits: No adopted application object/function design or privilege behavior tests.

requirements.required_evidence: Exposed Data API schemas, grants/default privileges, roles/BYPASSRLS and RLS/policies
requirements.handling: Never assume provider defaults; inspect actual role privileges and policy coverage.

actual_evidence.basis: postgres-created public tables lack default browser/API CRUD grants; public auto-RLS trigger is enabled. Creator-specific default grants and function EXECUTE grants retained.
actual_evidence.limits: supabase_admin-created objects retain broad defaults; PUBLIC function execution remains. Live Data API configuration and actual role/RLS behavior not verified.

requirements.required_evidence: 177 source-model routes,12 compatibility mirrors and architecture-required storage reconciliation
requirements.handling: Validate proposed physical constraints/source separation before candidate DDL; current schema validation is not this review.

actual_evidence.basis: Source-only review reconciles all 177 original models, 214 staged models, 40-model foundation closure, 12 compatibility cases, SQL-only enforcement and complete access/test plans. Native Prisma 7.10.1 validates both review schemas.
actual_evidence.limits: Ready for Brain review, not approved or adopted. No DDL generated, target contact, installation, RLS behavior, replay or runtime proof under P0-C-01.

requirements.required_evidence: Disposable replay environment identity and reproducible toolchain/fixture plan
requirements.handling: No replay executed; require one ordered migration/RLS stream and actual allow/deny/constraint/concurrency tests.
requirements.planning_evidence: context/reconciliation/database-candidate-tests.json; plan only; actual disposable identity/image/replay/recovery NOT_OBTAINED

requirements.required_evidence: Backup/restore, retention, secrets handoff and nonproduction safe fixture obligations
requirements.handling: No real personal data or credentials in repository/evidence; lawful retention/provider facts remain external.

actual_evidence.basis: Connected technical access and sanitized metadata collection work without storing credentials in the repository. Synthetic fixtures remain required.
actual_evidence.limits: Actual backup/restore settings, retention and recovery guarantees remain external/unverified.

requirements.required_evidence: Reviewed adoption decision and exact source/migration/RLS/build versions
requirements.handling: A/B/C/posture selection requires actual evidence and recorded rationale; preference alone retains D.

smallest_external_action: Brain review of the fingerprinted candidate precedes source-only DDL generation. No new project/account/credential is needed for this review. Later exact disposable identity, reviewed SQL/execution authorization and affected preservation/backup evidence precede replay; provider/legal facts remain scoped.
requirement_scope: Fresh-target identity/environment and empty application namespace have actual evidence. VERIFIED denotes only the named requirement scope, never baseline adoption, replay, production security or feature readiness. Partial requirements retain explicit limits; the old-project observation remains immutable historical evidence.
